content:
Good evening, my name is Ben Frohman, I am a native Texan and love the outdoors. I am a polymath by trade and enjoy focusing on quantitative problems within mathematics and physics.

I recently stumbled upon Terrence Tao's Lean4 youtube videos as I was embarking on looking for deeper clues into the infamous Navier Stokes problem for 3D incompressible flow and wanted to take an esoteric view of the problem from a totally different lens.

I started working on the problem early April and had my first conjectures written down and notarized cryptographically through adobe software April 21st. Around the 30th of May I had successfully kernel checked some theorems through Lean4 and the last run I had GROK CLI assist with crashed my computer from some external python script and now I am having serious obfuscation issues with path/roots/and possible stale batteries. (honestly i couldn't tell you because this is the first time i have ever dabbled in codebase anything)... Anyways I did manage to have a few upstreamed packages to the infra// libraries of Lean4 and Mathlib4 for unique identifiers, theorems, etc.

Would anyone be willing to assist me in tidying up the project (not math calcs, or review, or order/format) Im sorely requesting help for proper organizational and step by step to push the final project and all its accompanied files and source materials as there are files with same names and with 1/10 of the content. It seems different build agent sessions were silo'd into different builds. However I have the full pieces scattered around. What a nightmare. I should of had this out like 2 weeks ago and I have come a long ways without a single soul holding my hand... but now its getting too risky(fear Im going to lose my work and my mind) or leak the entire thing before I am ready to share it. It has been an arduous few months going non stop at this for about 18 hours a day. I would most appreciate a hand and some of your time so I can get back to my wife and kiddo... she wants my hands on the chopping block lol.
